_readme: Edit freely. worlds[i].lessons are shown on the card between levels of that world (cycled in order). preBoss/postBoss frame the world boss (levels 41, 82, ... 369). The tone of Shadow Man goes from cryptic/menacing (world 1) to openly kind (world 9). 'reveal' plays after the final boss.
title: LIL SYNN: Broken Hearts
prologue: The neon playground was quiet tonight. Too quiet.
Shadow Man has taken the Girl in the Yellow Dress.
Gather the broken hearts. Follow the cat. Bring her home.

level1Encounter.before: So you followed me. Most people turn back at the gate.
level1Encounter.after: Not bad. Not enough. If you want her back, you will have to become someone who doesn't flinch. 368 more steps, LIL SYNN.

worlds.name: Neon Playground
worlds.intro: The swings creak on their own. Something is watching from the slide.
lessons: You hesitate before every jump. I can hear it.
The ground you fear is the same ground you stand on.
Every heart you gather was broken by somebody. Remember that.
Fall. Get up. That's the whole trick.
You keep looking back at the cat. Look forward.
worlds.preBoss: Show me what you do when you're afraid.
worlds.postBoss: You flinched less than yesterday. Keep the girl in your mind. I'll keep her safe until you're ready.

worlds.name: Graffiti Alley
worlds.intro: Twilight. Every wall here has someone's name on it. None of them are yours yet.
lessons: They wrote their names so they wouldn't be forgotten. What are you leaving?
Walls are only walls until you climb them.
The crowd's opinion is paint. It washes off in the rain.
You don't need a face to be seen. You need a voice.
Stop asking the walls for permission.
worlds.postBoss: You stopped waiting for permission. Good. She asked about you today.

worlds.name: Sunrise Rooftops
worlds.intro: Morning on the rooftops. The gaps between buildings look wider in daylight.
lessons: The sun comes up whether you're ready or not. Be ready.
Looking down is a choice.
A long jump is just a short jump you committed to.
Confidence isn't loud. It's steady.
You're higher than you've ever been. Notice that.
worlds.preBoss: At the edge, everyone finds out who they are.
worlds.postBoss: You didn't look down once. I noticed. So did she.

worlds.name: Sunset City
worlds.intro: The city glows gold and every window is a stranger.
lessons: Nobody is thinking about you as much as you are.
You don't have to be the loudest. You have to be the truest.
A city is just a lot of people who were scared once.
You keep the hood up. Good. Let them hear you first.
The day ends. You don't.
worlds.preBoss: A thousand eyes. Do you shrink, or do you shine?
worlds.postBoss: You shined. Don't make that face; I'm allowed to be proud.

worlds.name: Rainy Neon Street
worlds.intro: Rain on neon. The reflections make it look like two cities, one upside down.
lessons: Rain doesn't stop the music. It just changes the beat.
Your reflection isn't weaker than you. It's just quieter.
Heartbreak is weather. It passes. You stay.
Wet ground is slippery. So is self-doubt. Both: keep moving.
Some storms you wait out. Some you walk through. Learn the difference.
worlds.preBoss: Let's see you dance in it.
worlds.postBoss: You walked through it. Most people wait under the awning forever.

worlds.name: Underground Relics
worlds.intro: Below the city: old tunnels, older stories. Some of them are about you.
lessons: Everything you buried is still down here. That's fine. It's yours.
Old mistakes make good stepping stones.
You're not who you were. Prove it gently.
Relics remind us. They don't define us.
The dark isn't empty. It's full of things you haven't named yet.
worlds.preBoss: I am every time you gave up. Fight me kindly.
worlds.postBoss: You forgave yourself in there. That's the hardest hit you'll ever land.

worlds.name: Archive Vault
worlds.intro: Rows and rows of saved moments. Every song you never finished is filed here.
lessons: Unfinished isn't failed. It's paused.
You've been keeping score of your losses. Start keeping score of your returns.
Every track you make is a letter to someone you haven't met.
The archive remembers. You get to choose what's next.
Ship it. Then make the next one better.
worlds.preBoss: Let's open the file you're most afraid of.
worlds.postBoss: You read it out loud. You're braver than the person who wrote it.

worlds.name: Nebula Path
worlds.intro: No more ground. Just light, and the space between the light.
lessons: When there's nothing beneath you, trust what's inside you.
Stars are just old light that kept going.
Being small in a big universe is not the same as being nothing.
You don't need to see the whole path. Just the next step.
I was never trying to stop you. Think about that.
worlds.preBoss: The void is honest. Are you?
worlds.postBoss: One more door. She's on the other side. So is the truth.

worlds.name: Cosmic Portal
worlds.intro: The portal hums the first song you ever made.
lessons: You already know how this ends. You just have to walk there.
Strong. Unafraid. Confident. Say it until it's boring.
Everything you learned, you already had. I only turned the lights off.
The girl is fine. She's been waiting to see who you'd become.
Last steps. Make them loud.
worlds.preBoss: Last lesson. Hit me with everything I taught you.
worlds.postBoss: That's it. That's who you are.

reveal: The shadows fall away. The fedora drops. Underneath there is no monster, only light shaped like a man.
"I was never your enemy, LIL SYNN. I was the part of you that wouldn't let you stay small."
"Every lesson was yours. I just held the dark so you could learn to shine in it."
The Girl in the Yellow Dress steps out of the portal, unharmed, smiling. "He kept me safe," she says. "He said you'd come when you were ready."
"Be strong. Be unafraid. Be confident. And when someone else is lost in the dark... be their Shadow Man."
